source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, Map objects and points of interest (provisional, item 59)

items.name: Crate
items.text: Crates, sandbags, low wreckage: half cover. Can be shot to pieces.

items.name: Low wall
items.text: Waist-high masonry or plating: half cover.

items.name: Pillar
items.text: A pillar, pylon or hull plate: full cover, blocks sight.

items.name: Barricade
items.text: Something built to keep people out. Break it, climb it, or find another way.

items.name: Door
items.text: Closed, it blocks movement and sight. Opening or closing costs 1 AP in a fight. A locked door needs a key, a check or a lot of damage.

items.name: Hole
items.text: A pit, shaft or breach. Nobody walks across; what happens to someone who falls is the Narrator's call.

items.name: Trap
items.text: Hidden until spotted: passive Vigilant (10 + modifier) against its TN, within 2 tiles. Stepping on it deals its damage and springs it. Disarming is a check.

items.name: Fire
items.text: Burning ground: 10 damage to anyone who starts a turn in it.

items.name: Toxic spill
items.text: Chemicals or bad mana: 8 damage to anyone who starts a turn in it.

items.name: Explosive barrel
items.text: Half cover until it isn't: at 0 HP it explodes for 40 within 2 tiles and leaves fire.

items.name: Rubble
items.text: What's left of broken cover: slow ground, no cover.

items.name: Container
items.text: A locker, chest or cargo box. What's inside is the Narrator's; opening a locked one is a check.

items.name: Terminal
items.text: A console or machine. Using it is a check, usually Proficiency.

items.name: Lamp
items.text: A work lamp, flare or brazier: lights 3 tiles around it, so darkness doesn't halve sight there. Shoot it out to make the dark.

items.name: Point of interest
items.text: Something worth a closer look. Examine it, and the Narrator writes the ways to deal with it.

items.name: Way out
items.text: Where this map leads elsewhere. Travel is the Narrator's call.

items.name: Camera
items.text: Watches a cone of the room. Slicers can blind it; shot, it goes dark.

items.name: Alarm panel
items.text: Raises the alarm when tripped. Slicers can silence it.

items.name: Emplaced turret
items.text: A fixed gun on a mount. The Narrator runs it as an enemy; Slicers can take it over (a static device).
